name: Multi-Directional Sampling of Boundary Paths
definition: A method to numerically estimate the boundary integral in Eq. 3.3 by avoiding explicit silhouette detection. It samples the material boundary segment pS0 pD0 and uses standard methods (unidirectional/bidirectional path sampling) to construct source and detector subpaths.
summary: Multi-Directional Sampling of Boundary Paths is a Monte Carlo technique that estimates boundary integrals by decoupling boundary segments from source and detector subpaths, avoiding explicit silhouette detection.
